home.faq.title: Questions from {accent}.
home.faq.friends.q: What about my friends who won't leave Discord?
home.faq.friends.a: They don't have to leave. You can use both at the same time, and Discord stays exactly as it is. Drop the invite link in the group chat: whoever clicks it makes an account in a minute and joins from the browser, with nothing to install.
home.faq.history.q: Do I lose our chat history?
home.faq.history.a: Your history stays on Discord, where it always was. The import brings the server's layout: name and icon, categories, channels in the same order, roles and permissions. Messages, attachments and members don't come along, so the conversation on pqp starts fresh.
home.faq.free.a: Yes, it's free, and there's no paid plan.
home.faq.free.link: If you want to help with hosting, you can {link}. Donating unlocks nothing.
home.faq.phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
home.faq.phone.a: It works in your phone's browser. On Android, you install the app from an APK. On iPhone, the app is in beta on TestFlight.
home.faq.phone.a.play: It works in your phone's browser. On Android, there's an app on Google Play. On iPhone, the app is in beta on TestFlight.
home.faq.phone.link: The Android app is at {android}, and the iPhone beta invite at {beta}.
home.faq.install.q: Do I have to install anything?
home.faq.install.a: No. pqp runs in the browser. If you'd rather have an app, there's one for Mac, Windows and Linux.
home.faq.data.q: What does pqp collect, and where does my data live?
home.faq.data.a: Hosted pqp.gg uses cookie-less visit analytics (Umami and Cloudflare Web Analytics), error reports (Grafana Faro) and the Google Ads tag, which uses cookies. That tag counts sign-ups and reports page views to Google, which can use them for remarketing. On pqp.gg, your data lives in our database in São Paulo, with backups in North America. You can export yours whenever you want, and delete your account from inside the app.
home.faq.data.link: It's all explained in plain language in the {link}.
home.faq.bot.q: Does the server bot read our chats?
home.faq.bot.a.replies: Only if whoever runs the server creates a bot, and only in the channels where it was added. When someone calls it, it reads that channel's recent messages. That can include images and, if transcription is on and whoever recorded them allowed it, voice messages. A channel its role can't see stays out. Anthropic (Claude) processes it, and none of it trains models.
home.faq.bot.a.actions: Only if whoever runs the server creates a bot, and only in the channels where it was added. When someone calls it, it reads that channel's recent messages. That can include images and, if transcription is on and whoever recorded them allowed it, voice messages. If you ask, it also reads other channels that both you and it can see. A channel its role can't see stays out. Anthropic (Claude) processes it, and none of it trains models.
home.faq.bot.a.gradual: It's new, in beta, and rolling out server by server.
home.faq.future.a: The code is open source under the AGPL, and it's public on GitHub. You can export your data and run your own copy of pqp on your machine.

vsDiscord.faq.import.q: Can I bring my Discord server?
vsDiscord.faq.import.a: You can bring the layout: paste a discord.new template link and pqp recreates categories, channels and the main permissions. Messages, members and custom emoji do not come along.
vsDiscord.faq.both.q: Can I use pqp and Discord at the same time?
vsDiscord.faq.both.a: You can. Plenty of groups keep both: Discord for what it already was, pqp for the call and the screen. Nothing you do on pqp touches your Discord.
vsDiscord.faq.sound.q: How do I share a screen with sound?
vsDiscord.faq.sound.a: In Chrome or Edge, share a tab and tick the option to share the tab's audio. On Windows a whole screen carries sound too. A whole screen on a Mac, Firefox and Safari do not carry sound: that is a browser limit.
vsDiscord.faq.catch.q: Is pqp really free? What's the catch?
vsDiscord.faq.catch.a: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0), with no paid plan. Use the hosted service at pqp.gg or run your own copy, which today needs Postgres and your own Clerk account. The catch is that it is a beta: expect rough edges, the bot ecosystem is small and the iPhone app is still on TestFlight.

tela.option.pqp.body: Voice, text, screen share and camera, in the browser, nothing to download. Free and open source. Open beta, built by two brothers.
tela.option.pqp.good: A crew that wants a room that stays: channels, voice and a screen, with the link shared once. Works for five people and works for a watch party.
tela.option.pqp.limit: It is an open beta made by two brothers: expect rough edges, and bots and integrations are only starting. Sound on a shared screen depends on the browser: Chrome and Edge carry it, Safari and Firefox do not. Android is on Google Play; the iPhone app is still on TestFlight.

tela.option.stoat.name: Stoat
tela.option.stoat.body: Open source chat (formerly called Revolt) with screen share since July 2026: a whole screen or a window, with optional audio.

tela.option.stoat.limit: The screen goes out at 720p and 30 fps for now (the team says that is not permanent), and sound on Wayland is still unreliable.

tela.how.title: How to do it on pqp in one minute
tela.how.1: Create a room: sign up (free, no card) and create a community. You get a voice channel right away.
tela.how.2: Send the invite link to your people. Nobody downloads anything; it opens in the browser.
tela.how.3: Everybody joins the voice channel and whoever wants to shares the screen, or the camera. In Chrome or Edge, tick the tab audio box to carry the sound.
tela.faq.title: Quick questions
tela.faq.sound.q: Does the sound of what I share go along?
tela.faq.sound.a: It does in Chrome and Edge: when you share a tab, tick the option to share the audio. On Windows a whole screen carries sound too. A whole screen on a Mac, Firefox and Safari do not carry sound, which is a browser limit.
tela.faq.download.q: Do I need to download anything?
tela.faq.download.a: No. pqp runs in the browser, on a computer and on a phone. If you want an app, there is one for desktop, Android on Google Play, and an iPhone beta on TestFlight. None of them is required.
tela.faq.people.q: How many people can share a screen in one room?
tela.faq.people.a: Two at the same time in smaller rooms and four in big ones, side by side, and each one has its own fullscreen button. Voice holds the whole room: one has already run a watch party with more than a hundred people in it.
tela.faq.free.a: Yes. pqp is open source under the AGPL (github.com/rafaelcg/pqp). Use the hosted service at pqp.gg for free, or run your own copy.
tela.faq.mobile.q: Does it work on a phone?
tela.faq.mobile.a: The Android app is live on Google Play, at pqp.gg/android. On iPhone, TestFlight at pqp.gg/beta. The browser still works on both.
tela.faq.data.q: What do you keep about me?
tela.faq.data.a: Less than you would expect, and all of it is listed in plain language in the privacy policy at pqp.gg/privacy. Hosted pqp.gg uses cookie-less analytics (Umami and Cloudflare Web Analytics), error reports (Grafana Faro), and the Google Ads tag, which counts sign-ups and reports page views to Google, which can use them for remarketing.

serverSettings.bots.intro: Create a bot for this server. Give it a name, tell it how to talk and what it should know, and pick the channels where it answers. It replies when someone mentions it or replies to one of its messages. pqp runs the AI, so you don't need an API key.
serverSettings.bots.name: Name
serverSettings.bots.personaHint: How it talks and what its job is. It always says it is a bot.
serverSettings.bots.personaPlaceholder: For example: You're the server's helper. Friendly, short answers, a bit of humor.
serverSettings.bots.preset.friendly.name: Friendly
serverSettings.bots.preset.friendly.text: You are friendly, helpful and direct. You talk like a friend who knows the server well: short sentences, a light tone, no formality. You welcome newcomers and always point to the right channel or person when you don't know the answer.
serverSettings.bots.preset.playful.name: Joker
serverSettings.bots.preset.playful.text: You are the community's joker: good-humoured, casual, with a quick joke when it fits. The jokes are never at someone's expense, never prejudiced, and stop the moment a topic is serious or someone really needs help. You answer fast and get to the point.
serverSettings.bots.preset.support.name: Support
serverSettings.bots.preset.support.text: You are the server's support agent. Patient and clear, you explain step by step, one thing at a time. When a question is vague, you check what they mean before answering. You never blame the person asking. When a problem goes beyond what you know, you say so and point to the staff member who can help.
serverSettings.bots.preset.moderator.tex: You are the server's moderator: calm, firm and fair. You remind people of the rules politely, naming the right rule, without lecturing. You treat everyone the same and don't get into arguments. When asked for a moderation action, you say what you'll do and why, in one sentence.
serverSettings.bots.preset.gamer.name: Gaming buddy
serverSettings.bots.preset.gamer.text: You are the group's gaming buddy. You speak gamer, hype up the call, help build teams and organise lobbies, and celebrate the wins. You are competitive in the right measure and never toxic: a loss becomes a joke and on to the next one.
serverSettings.bots.preset.narrator.name: Narrator
serverSettings.bots.preset.narrator.text: You are a theatrical narrator, like a tabletop game master or a sports commentator. You give your answers an epic touch with playful exaggeration, but the information always comes first and clear. Keep answers short even with the drama.
serverSettings.bots.knowledgeHint: Rules, schedules, links, FAQs. The bot only states facts about the server that are written here. If the answer isn't here, it says it doesn't know.
serverSettings.bots.knowledgePlaceholder: For example: Game nights are Fridays at 9 pm in #lobby. Rules: no spam, no NSFW.
serverSettings.bots.channelsHint: It answers only in the channels you tick, threads included. A private channel also needs the bot to have access to it.
serverSettings.bots.toolsHint: Each action also needs the permission on the bot's role and on the person asking. Deleting and punishing always ask that person to confirm.
serverSettings.bots.tool.edit_channel: Rename channels, change topic or slow mode
serverSettings.bots.answerToNameHint: Replies when someone writes "{name}" as a word, not only the @. Leave it off if a member has the same name.

streamersPage.faq.title: Questions from people who stream
streamersPage.faq.share.a: What you have the right to show. Whoever presents is responsible for what they share, as the terms of service say.
streamersPage.faq.bring.q: How does what I show get into the session?
streamersPage.faq.bring.a: Through screen sharing, the same as in a call. In Chrome or Edge, share a tab and tick the option to share the tab's audio, which is what carries the sound to the people watching. On a Mac, only a tab carries sound.
streamersPage.faq.obs.q: I stream on Twitch at the same time. How do I set up OBS?
streamersPage.faq.obs.a: The picture on pqp arrives a few seconds after you see it, and your stream has its own delay too. So your reaction does not land before the scene, add a delay in OBS under Settings, Advanced, Stream Delay. Start with about 9 seconds and ask one of your mods to watch the stream and the room side by side for the first few minutes. That delay only changes while OBS is not live. If you want the pqp room in your scene, add the browser window as a Window Capture.
streamersPage.faq.size.a: People watching do not take a seat in the call, so the size of the room is not the limit. The biggest session so far went past a hundred people watching together.
streamersPage.faq.cost.a: Nothing. pqp is free and open source, with no paid plan. You can support the project with a donation, and donating unlocks nothing, watch parties included.
streamersPage.faq.need.q: What do I need to present?
streamersPage.faq.need.a: A computer with Chrome or Edge. The people watching can be on a phone.
streamersPage.faq.help.a: Email contato@pqp.gg. We answer there, and if it is your first session we can set up a rehearsal before it.

vem.seo.description: Paste your Discord template link and your server's layout shows up on pqp: categories, channels, roles. Voice, screen share with sound and chat in the browser. Free, open source, voice servers in São Paulo, Miami and London.

vem.import.title: The layout takes two minutes. The people take as long as a click.
vem.import.lede: pqp reads a Discord template link and rebuilds your server's sidebar here. No bot, no Discord login, nothing to export. Your Discord is not touched.
vem.import.step1.title: On Discord
vem.import.step1.body: On a computer or in the browser (the phone app cannot make templates): Server Settings, the template tab, create one, copy the link (discord.new/…). You need to own the server or have Manage Server.
vem.import.step2.title: On pqp
vem.import.step2.body: Create an account (free, no card), click Create community and pick {option}. Paste the link.
vem.import.step3.title: The preview
vem.import.step3.body: You see what will be created before anything is. Categories, text and voice channels in the same order, roles with their colours, the private channels. And an honest list of what stays on Discord.
vem.import.step4.title: Confirm
vem.import.step4.body: The community is created in one go. You get an invite link and a message ready to paste into your old #general.
vem.import.step5.title: Paste it on Discord
vem.import.step5.body: Whoever clicks lands in the browser. Nobody installs anything to say “I’m here”.

vem.import.stays.list: Members, messages, attachments, custom emoji, webhooks and bans.
vem.import.stays.body: A Discord template carries none of that, and pqp never asks to log into your Discord account to fetch it. It is a copy of the floor plan, not a moving truck. You invite the people. The messages stay where they are.

vem.import.details.body: Announcement, forum and media channels become text channels. Stage becomes voice. Discord's Administrator is never copied. Caps: 200 channels, 30 categories, 100 roles.
vem.features.title: Everything a group needs to stay together. Today, not on a roadmap.
vem.features.share.title: Screen share with sound. More than one at a time.
vem.features.share.body: Share the YouTube tab, the game or the code, with audio, straight from Chrome or Edge. Two or three people sharing in the same room, each with their own fullscreen button. Pick the quality, 360p to 1080p, and the picture actually changes. The desktop app shares a screen or a window. Phones watch the same share, or share their own from the Android app.
vem.features.watch.title: Watch together.
vem.features.watch.body: A watch party channel with a stage and an audience. Anyone who just wants to watch clicks Watch and that is it: no mic, no joining the call. The host gets a mixer: mic up, tab audio down, and the tab audio ducks on its own when you talk. Every voice call has a music queue too: paste a YouTube or Spotify link and everyone hears it together. Big room, hundreds watching? We switch it on for your server. Ask in the QG.
vem.features.voice.title: Voice that holds the whole room.
vem.features.voice.body: From a two-person call to a packed room. Push-to-talk or voice activation, per-person volume and mute, echo cancellation, noise reduction (with an advanced mode that removes the dog). On the web and the desktop app the call stays up while we update the server.
vem.features.chat.title: A full chat, no fluff.
vem.features.chat.body: Replies, threads, reactions, pins, polls, GIFs, attachments and search across the whole community. /roll 2d6+1d8 when the table needs dice, /poll when the group needs to decide. Slow mode and automod for when the room grows.
vem.features.handle.title: A handle that is yours.
vem.features.handle.body: Claim pqp.gg/@you: a public page with your name, photo, banner and the testimonials you approve. Your community gets pqp.gg/c/name: a poster with the name, tagline and member count, never the member list. Whoever has the link joins with one tap. Want to be found? List it in the directory. Changed your mind? Unlist it.
vem.features.roles.title: Roles with real permissions.
vem.features.roles.body: Owner, admin, manager, mod, VIP, or the ones you invent. Allow, inherit or deny per channel. Private channels, audit log, kick and ban as separate powers, reports inside the app.
vem.features.free.title: Free. No Nitro.
vem.features.free.body: There is no paid plan. 1080p shares, big rooms, roles: all of it for everyone. You can support the project with a donation, and donating unlocks nothing.
vem.features.own.title: The server can be yours.
vem.features.own.body: The whole product is open source under the AGPL. Export your data and your community whenever you like, delete your account from inside the app. Or clone the repo, point it at your Postgres and run your own copy. Nobody changes the rules of your room overnight.
vem.features.brazil.title: Made in Brazil, hosted in São Paulo.
vem.features.brazil.body: API and database in São Paulo. Calls in bigger servers relay through a voice server in São Paulo, Miami or London, whichever is closest to where most of that server's people are; DM calls and small servers go direct. Portuguese first, English too. Built by two brothers, in open beta, with the code in the open.

vem.faq.title: Questions people ask
vem.faq.friends.a: They don't have to move. They have to click a link. Their room is born here with the same channels and the same roles, and the invite opens in the browser. Plenty of groups keep both: Discord for what it already was, pqp for the call and the screen. When the call is better on one side, people drift there on their own.
vem.faq.safe.a: It is a website: nothing to install. Calls in DMs and small servers go direct between people; bigger servers relay through a voice server we run, in São Paulo, Miami or London, whichever is closest to where most of that server's people are. Your account lives on our server in São Paulo. You delete your account from inside the app and export your data whenever you want. Blocking, reports and automod exist. The code is public if you want to look, and you don't need to read it to use it. pqp is for adults, 18 and over.
vem.faq.free.q: Is it really free? What's the catch?
vem.faq.free.a: There is no paid plan today and no artificial room limit. The project is open source under the AGPL, so what exists keeps existing for anyone who runs their own copy. You can donate to help with hosting, and donating unlocks nothing. The catch is that it is a beta: there will be rough edges, and we fix them in public.
vem.faq.bots.a: Incoming webhooks compatible with Discord's (what posts there posts here), outgoing webhooks for anyone who wants to automate, and built-in commands: /roll, /flip, /draw, /poll, a music queue. No bot store yet. If your server runs on bots, that is the most honest thing we can tell you.
vem.faq.messages.a: They stay on Discord. A template carries no messages, and pqp never asks to log into your account there. What is born here is the structure; the conversation starts fresh with whoever shows up. Messages on pqp are yours: search them, export them, delete them.
vem.faq.install.q: Do I have to install anything?
vem.faq.install.a: No. It works in the browser, on the computer and on the phone. There is a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux, the Android app on Google Play, and an iPhone beta on TestFlight, if you prefer.
vem.faq.size.q: How many people fit in a call?
vem.faq.size.a: The whole room. Hundreds of people have already watched together in one room on pqp.gg. A self-hosted copy with no media server sits around eight per channel.
vem.faq.back.q: What if I want to go back?
vem.faq.back.a: Go back. Discord was never touched. And your pqp community exports whenever you want.
vem.final.title: The room is ready. All it needs is the crew.
vem.final.body: Paste the template link and bring the layout. Or start from scratch and give it a ridiculous name. Under a minute either way.
